items.exampleEn: Writing down a clear plan helped her achieve a goal she'd had for years.
items.exampleZh: 寫下清楚的計畫，幫助她達成了一個多年來的目標。

items.exampleEn: The train was late. As a result, I missed the start of the show.
items.exampleZh: 火車誤點了，因此我錯過了表演的開頭。

items.exampleEn: Driving without a license is breaking the law.
Talking about the weather can break the ice.
items.exampleZh: 聊聊天氣可以打破僵局。

items.exampleEn: Many airlines are trying to cut costs.
items.exampleZh: 很多航空公司都在想辦法削減成本。

items.exampleEn: Our company does business with several banks in Japan.
items.exampleZh: 我們公司和日本好幾家銀行有生意往來。

items.exampleEn: Volunteering is a good way to gain experience.
items.exampleZh: 當志工是累積經驗的好方法。

items.sentenceEn: He didn't know he was breaking the law.

items.audioEn: We stopped doing business with that supplier because their deliveries were always late.
items.audioZh: 我們不再和那家供應商做生意，因為他們送貨總是遲到。
items.questionZh: 他們為什麼不再和那家供應商合作？
options: Their prices rose a lot this year
Its goods never arrived on time

items.sentenceEn: Summer jobs help students gain experience.
items.sentenceZh: 暑期工作幫助學生累積經驗。

items.sentenceEn: Let's play a quick game to break the ice.
items.sentenceZh: 我們玩個簡單的遊戲來破冰吧。

items.stemEn: It rained all morning. ____, the outdoor concert was moved inside.
items.stemZh: 下了一整個早上的雨，因此戶外音樂會移到室內舉行。

items.stemEn: Turning off the lights at night is one easy way to ____ in an office.
items.stemZh: 晚上關燈是辦公室削減成本的簡單方法之一。

items.passageEn: After college, Rita worked at a bakery for two years to gain experience. Her plan was simple: open her own bakery before the age of thirty. To achieve a goal like that, she saved carefully and learned how a business works. Last year, she opened a small shop and started doing business with local farmers, who sell her fresh eggs and butter. She also cut costs by making her own boxes. As a result, her prices are lower than those of most bakeries in town.
items.passageZh: 大學畢業後，Rita 在一家麵包店工作了兩年，累積經驗。她的計畫很簡單：三十歲前開一家自己的麵包店。為了達成這樣的目標，她小心存錢，也學習生意是怎麼運作的。去年，她開了一家小店，開始和當地農夫做生意，向他們買新鮮的雞蛋和奶油。她也自己做盒子來削減成本。因此，她的價格比鎮上大部分的麵包店都低。

questions.questionZh: Rita 一開始為什麼去麵包店工作？
Rita 的麵包為什麼比較便宜？
options: 當地農夫免費送她雞蛋和奶油
她自己做盒子，省下成本

items.promptZh: 他講了一個笑話來打破僵局。
referenceEn: He told a joke to break the ice.
He broke the ice by telling a joke.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「打破僵局」（例如 to break the ice 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 eased the tension、lightened the mood 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 told、has told 等）
「講笑話」可寫，例如 told a joke、telling a joke 等

items.promptZh: 我想在大公司累積經驗。
referenceEn: I want to gain experience at a big company.
I'd like to gain experience in a large company.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「累積經驗」（例如 gain experience 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 get experience、build experience 等）
「想」可寫，例如 want to、would like to 等
「大公司」可寫，例如 a big company、a large company 等；介系詞用 at 或 in 都正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：中文題目是「累積一些經驗」，最自然的譯法是 gain some experience，但評分要點寫「片語中間不加字」，會把 gain some experience 判錯；參考答案也都漏譯「一些」。建議允許 gain some experience，或把題目的「一些」拿掉。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：中文題目改為「我想在大公司累積經驗。」（拿掉「一些」，兩個參考答案即完整對應）；評分要點刪去「片語中間不加字」
